task.title: Gregorian leap-year function
task.prompt: Write a Python module defining is_leap(year: int) -> bool for the Gregorian calendar.

checks.test_code:
from solution import is_leap
assert is_leap(2024)
assert not is_leap(2023)
assert not is_leap(1900), '1900 is not a leap year'
assert is_leap(2000)
assert not is_leap(2100)
print('5 tests passed')
